title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2635 Napa Street in Vallejo, California, as the "Janet Capello Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2635 Napa Street in Vallejo, California, as the "Janet Capello Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Vallejo, California, after Janet Capello.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2635 Napa Street in Vallejo, California, as the "Janet Capello Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018, and the name took effect on that date.
